errors.text_span: The x-axis represents the layer number and is scaled linearly from 1 to 32
errors.evidence: The x-axis is categorical with grouped labels (Layer1-4, Layer5-12, Layer13-20, Layer21-28, Layer29-32), not a linear 1-to-32 numeric axis.

errors.text_span: with tick marks spaced every 1% increment
errors.evidence: The y-axis tick labels are spaced at 5% intervals (5%, 0%, -5%, -10%, -15%), not 1% increments.

errors.text_span: The first line, colored orange and represented by circular markers, corresponds to LB-Avg of 2×tokens, 8-bit
errors.evidence: The legend shows LB-Avg of 2×tokens,8-bit as a yellow/orange line with circular markers, but the description’s later value claims for this series are incorrect.

errors.text_span: displaying a consistent value around -2%, with a minimum value of -6% at Layer13-20 and a maximum value of -2% at Layer1-4
errors.evidence: This series is around 0% to -1% overall, not around -2% with a minimum of -6%; the figure shows about -1% at Layer5-12, near 0% at Layer13-20, about -0.5% at Layer21-28, and slightly above 0% at Layer29-32.

errors.text_span: The second line, colored red and represented by circular markers
errors.evidence: The red series uses square markers, not circular markers.

errors.text_span: also exhibiting a consistent value around -3%, with a minimum value of -9% at Layer13-20 and a maximum value of -3% at Layer1-4
errors.evidence: The red series is around 0%, -2.5%, -2%, -2%, and 0%, with a minimum near -2.5%, not -9%.

errors.text_span: The third line, colored blue and represented by circular markers
errors.evidence: The third series in the figure is light blue with circular markers, but the description later conflates it with the wrong values; additionally, the dark blue series is the one with square markers.

errors.text_span: showing a value ranging from -5% to 0%, with a minimum of -12% at Layer13-20 and a maximum of 0% at Layer1-4
errors.evidence: The light blue series reaches about -6% at Layer13-20 and is not as low as -12%; it is roughly 0% at Layer1-4 and about -1% at Layer29-32.

errors.text_span: Finally, the fourth line, colored teal and represented by dashed markers
errors.evidence: The fourth line is dark blue with square markers; the dashed grey line is the baseline, not this series.

errors.text_span: with a value consistently around -4%, exhibiting a minimum of -10% at Layer13-20 and a maximum of -4% at Layer1-4
errors.evidence: The dark blue series is about -1%, -5.5%, -14.5%, -11%, and -1.5%, so it is not consistently around -4% and its minimum is near -15%, not -10%.

errors.text_span: while a dashed line representing the baseline of 4×tokens, 4-bit, is present across all layers with a value of 0%
errors.evidence: The baseline is correctly dashed grey at 0%, but the description incorrectly treats it as an additional line after misidentifying the fourth series; this part is otherwise accurate.
